title: Guided compatibility-matrix migration sprint & release comms playbook
creator: Nora Kim
description:
Summary: This ticket coordinates a timeboxed migration sprint that will revise the public compatibility matrix for model variants and introduce a guided migration experience, paired release notes templates, and a multi-channel communications timeline. Objective is to reduce upgrade friction for production customers, minimize support load during the cutover window, and ensure docs/SDKs/examples match runtime behavior.

Scope:
- Finalize the compatibility matrix for runtime-2.4.0 (model families, quantization tiers, KV cache behavior, and feature flags).
- Deliver a guided migration flow in our Console (migration checklist + one-click suggested config where safe).
- Ship a set of release-note artifacts: customer-facing summary, technical upgrade notes, changelog snippet for SDKs, and migration checklist for Platform Integrations.
- Coordinate go-to-market comms (in-product banner, email cohorts, statuspage, partner notice) and enable Support/CS.

Out of scope: automated in-place runtime migrations or forced model conversions. Deep kernel-level compatibility fixes belong to ENG-4031.

Links: PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/Versioning-2.4-Compat-Matrix (internal)
Staging Console prototype: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1migr-proto
Engineering epic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/epics/24
Support playbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/Support-Playbook-7628
acceptance_criteria: Published compatibility matrix doc on Confluence with sign-off from Runtime, SDK, and Docs leads
Console migration checklist implemented in staging and validated against three customer scenarios
Customer-facing release note and technical upgrade notes published and translated (EN/FR/DE)
Support and Sales runbook distributed with triage flows and canned responses
Post-release monitoring dashboard (latency & error delta by customer cohort) configured and receiving telemetry

2026-02-28: Design (Priya Shah) delivered wireframes for Console migration checklist. UX review noted potential X complexity for multi-model configs; agreed to simplify by surfacing only recommended settings for first release.

2026-03-05: Support/CS playbook v0.3 received feedback from CS lead (David Huang): add escalation path for customers on Dedicated capacity. Ticket PM-7032 created to track partner comms for Dedicated.

2026-03-10: Staging migration flow validated with two internal customer accounts (acct-alpha, acct-beta). Found a minor bug where cached prefix sizes were not surfaced; ENG-4175 created and scheduled for 2026-03-16 fix.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Unexpected behavioral delta causes customer regressions. Mitigation: Early adopter cohort + canary rollout by region + fallback model variant policy.
Risk: Docs and SDKs out of sync causing developer errors. Mitigation: Block GA release until SDK lint and release-note snippets land; require cross-team sign-off checkbox.
Risk: High support volume post-release. Mitigation: Create canned responses, route Dedicated customers to tiered support, prepare runbook for SRE to rollback traffic routing if needed.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21): Finalize compatibility matrix, lock release-note templates, staging validation
Phase 1 - Early Adopter Pre-announce (2026-03-22): Email to early-adopter cohort + in-console opt-in banner
Phase 2 - Canary (2026-03-29): 5% traffic to runtime-2.4.0 for sandbox and selected production customers; monitor key metrics for 72h
Phase 3 - Gradual Rollout (2026-03-31 to 2026-04-07): 5% incremental increase per day with rollback gates
Phase 4 - GA & Public Release (2026-04-08): Public release notes, blog post, SDK patch release, wider email and statuspage update

In-product banner with 'Read migration guide' CTA for 14 days pre-GA

Three end-to-end migration test cases (simple app, conversational app with long histories, high-throughput embedding pipeline)
Performance soak test targeting 72h at expected production QPS for canary cohort
SDK integration tests to flag deprecated params and surfaced warnings
